verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a speech-to-text API and model, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers retention periods, deletion of uploaded audio or transcripts, or zero-retention options. The docs only describe uploading audio and receiving transcripts. The GitHub items show local installation and use, but local execution is not a documented retention or deletion control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
